adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in EventManager.ts around line 516-519, when merging bookings (newBookingId case), the code still uses `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes('_calendar'))` to get the old calendar event to delete. However, the rest of the code in this function was refactored to use `.filter()` instead of `.find()` to handle multiple calendar references (lines 493-495). This inconsistency means that when merging bookings with collective scheduling (multiple host calendars), only the first old calendar event will be deleted, leaving orphaned events on other hosts' calendars.
